name: Houkago Choukyou Club ~Hokenshitsu no Mesudorei~
original_name: 放課後調教倶楽部～保健室の牝奴隷～
source:
Emi is dumped on his boy friend because she refused when he tried to make love with her. She talks about this story to her friend, Iriya. He understands her very well and she is getting relaxed. Suddenly, he whispers in her ear...

translation:
当麻绘美拒绝与男友做爱，因此遭到对方抛弃。她将这件事告诉朋友入谷，对方十分体贴地理解了她，绘美也渐渐放松下来。就在这时，入谷突然凑到她耳边低声说道……
